rules.label: Week 4 of every month
rules.text: deload. Do half the sets, same effort.

rules.label: Stop rule
rules.text: 3 reps in a row under 90% of your session best (height, flight time or rotation) = that exercise is done for the day.

rules.label: Rest
rules.text: jumps and strength 2 min, contrast rounds 3 min, tricks 60 to 90 s, flexibility none.

rules.label: Ball height
rules.text: start at the height you hit 8/10. 8/10 = raise it 5 cm next session. Under 5/10 = lower it 5 cm.

rules.label: Film
rules.text: every trick set on Day 3 and Day 6.

rules: 6 to 8 micro-sets a day, every day, each 2 to 3 min.
Effort 50 to 70%. Never to failure, never a max stretch.
Rotate A, B, C, D through the day.
Day 1 and Day 4: skip set D (legs are fresh for power).
1 hour before and after the main session: no GTG.
Week 4 of every month: 4 sets a day instead of 6 to 8.
